value.rationale: Two rank-one projections constitute the canonical smallest noncommuting positive operator pair, parameterized without arbitrary slicing by their overlap. The exact joint-radius objective has a mathematically meaningful competition between two separate preferred rays and their symmetric compromise; the complete global equality-case classification exhibits a sharp symmetry-breaking threshold c=1/2 and nonanalytic square-root splitting. The exact second-order gain quantifies the change. This is a complete natural class classification rather than a generic numerical example, renaming, or unmotivated parameter slice; it does not require a general downstream theorem.
